We have displayCarStatus with option "fuel". That likely returns fuel status. Also estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage takes distance and returns feasibility. So we should call displayCarStatus with option "fuel" and estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage with distance 750.
